{"edits": [{"finding_ids": ["app/profiles.py:8:optional-no-default", "app/profiles.py:9:optional-no-default", "app/profiles.py:10:optional-no-default", "app/profiles.py:15:test-failure"], "search": "    bio: Optional[str]
    website: Optional[str]
    age: Optional[int]", "replace": "    bio: Optional[str] = None
    website: Optional[str] = None
    age: Optional[int] = None", "explanation": "In Pydantic V2, a field annotated Optional[T] with no default is required (see migration.md#required-optional-and-nullable-fields). Adding `= None` restores the V1 behavior where these fields default to None and may be omitted. This also fixes the test failure at line 15: profile_from_form drops keys whose values are "" or None, so bio/website/age are then absent from the kwargs, and without a default V2 raised 'Field required'. With the defaults in place, those omitted fields become None as the test expects. No change to profile_from_form is needed."}], "notes": "One edit covers lines 8-10 (non-overlapping, single contiguous block) and resolves all four findings, since the test failure at line 15 is caused by the same missing defaults: profile_from_form filters out blank/None values, so the omitted Optional fields must default to None. Left unchanged: `username: str` (required in both V1 and V2), `interests: List[str] = []` (already has a default; V2 copies mutable defaults per instance, so no change needed), and profile_from_form itself, whose behavior is preserved. No imports need to change; Optional is still used."}
